import subprocess

cmds = [
    "cat /opt/abb-sdk-repo/README.md",
    "echo '=== src ==='; find /opt/abb-sdk-repo/src -maxdepth 3 2>/dev/null | head -60",
    "echo '=== examples ==='; find /opt/abb-sdk-repo/examples -maxdepth 3 2>/dev/null | head -60",
    "echo '=== realtabbench ==='; find /opt/abb-sdk-repo/realtabbench -maxdepth 3 2>/dev/null | head -60",
    "echo '=== Makefile ==='; cat /opt/abb-sdk-repo/Makefile",
    "echo '=== pyproject ==='; cat /opt/abb-sdk-repo/pyproject.toml",
]
for c in cmds:
    print("="*70); print("$", c)
    r = subprocess.run(c, shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
    print((r.stdout or "(no output)")[:4000])
    if r.stderr.strip(): print("ERR:", r.stderr[:300])
